sources.entry: Digiscreen - Interactive whiteboard/wallpaper for the classroom, in person or remotely (documentation in French). (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Nodejs/PHP

summary.name: Digiscreen
summary.one_liner: Digiscreen is an interactive whiteboard and wallpaper for classrooms, usable in person or remotely, made by La Digitale.
use_cases: Displaying interactive content as a classroom wallpaper
Using timers, countdowns and clocks during class
Sharing QR codes, links and media with pupils
summary.what_it_does: The page is a French-language product page for Digiscreen, described as an interactive wallpaper for classrooms. The page text is mostly the navigation tool list, which names widgets including text, image, gallery, PDF, audio, video, link, embed, cloud, random text and random image, story/board, dice, traffic light, groups, timer, countdown, clock, calendar, feedback, grid, capture, annotate, screen, and trash bin. The page itself gives few details beyond this. Listing metadata notes it is documented in French and is listed on awesome-selfhosted under Learning and Courses, with a demo and source code linked.
notable: Collection of classroom widgets such as timers, dice, traffic light, random picker and annotation
Licensed AGPL-3.0 and listed on awesome-selfhosted
caveats: Page text requires JavaScript enabled and is mostly navigation labels; little detail beyond the tool list
Pricing not stated on the page
